acceptanceCriteria: One make target runs post-commit bind, check, seal and the CI doc-gates list from a variable that ci.yml also uses
A lane closeout needs one command after the CEM commit (retained transcript)
body: Observed 2026-10-18 in the V1-1879 lane: after committing the CEM, a lane runs make dogfood-change, make dogfood-check, make dogfood-seal, then a hand-kept local doc-gates list (memory: unbounded-readers-check, use-case receipts and gofmt -l are easy to miss; there is no doc-gates make target, ci.yml keeps its own list). Each step reads the same env inputs. Owner asked 2026-10-18 for less process and a smooth, fast flow. Expected: one target (e.g. make ship BASE=) that runs the post-commit bind, check, seal and the exact CI doc-gates list from one shared variable, stopping at the first failure with its fix line. Does not weaken any gate.
title: One closeout command: post-commit dogfood-change, dogfood-check, dogfood-seal and the CI doc-gates list as a single make target
